title: High-Dimensional Off-Policy Evaluation without Sample Splitting using an Onsager Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.08794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward models used for off-policy evaluation (OPE) are commonly selected using held-out data. When sample size and context dimension grow proportionally, the difference in test risk between models fitted on the full sample and on a fixed fraction of it need not vanish. Held-out evaluation can therefore consistently estimate the test risk of the model trained on the smaller sample, but because the relative ranking of candidate reward models can change after full-data refitting, held-out selection can be suboptimal. We develop an Onsager-corrected, target-policy-weighted criterion that estimates the full-data reward model's out-of-sample risk under the target policy using only its training observations. This enables early stopping along the full-data gradient-descent trajectory without sample splitting. translated_title: 使用翁萨格修正实现无需样本分割的高维离线策略评估
translated_abstract: 用于离线策略评估（OPE）的奖励模型通常需要借助留出数据进行选择。当样本量与上下文维度成比例增长时，在全样本上拟合的模型与在固定比例样本上拟合的模型之间的测试风险差异不一定趋于消失。因此，留出评估只能一致地估计在较小样本上训练的模型的测试风险，但由于候选奖励模型的相对排名在全数据重新拟合后可能发生变化，基于留出数据的选择可能是次优的。我们开发了一种经过Onsager修正、以目标策略加权的选择准则，该准则仅使用训练观测数据即可估计全数据奖励模型在目标策略下的样本外风险。这使得我们可以在全数据梯度下降轨迹上进行早停，而无需样本分割。对于高斯上下文下具有固定深度和隐藏层宽度的神经网络、单指标奖励以及依赖上下文的多指标目标……
tldr: 本文提出一种经Onsager修正且以目标策略加权的准则，仅利用训练观测数据即可估计全数据奖励模型在目标策略下的样本外风险，从而在高维离线策略评估中无需样本分割即可实现全数据梯度下降轨迹上的早停，克服了留出数据选择可能次优的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Onsager-corrected, target-policy-weighted criterion that estimates the full-data reward model's out-of-sample risk using only training observations, enabling early stopping along the full-data gradient-descent trajectory without sample splitting for high-dimensional off-policy evaluation.
